name: ollama
summary: Deploys the owned local Ollama model service for optional demo AI integrations.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the selected storage and model configuration when it remains valid.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before rollout when storage, image pull, model download, or requested GPU capacity is unavailable.

readiness: The owned Ollama deployment is ready and the selected model is available.

security.secret_storage: No model API key is required for the local default profile.
security.network_trust: Model pulls use configured registry trust.
security.external_actions: No hosted LLM provider is contacted by the local profile.
